decisions.reason: The aloe vera line builds moderately on chemical formulation knowledge and has a dedicated webpage suggesting commitment, but botanical extracts are less core, so the firm may still drop it.

The hyaluronic acid serum depends on biotechnological active-ingredient knowledge far from the firm's existing chemical product base, limiting its absorptive capacity and making it likely to be dropped.
The cleansing milk is closest to the firm's existing emulsification and surfactant expertise, enabling it to interpret early results and improve the product, so it is likely to be kept.
